source.name: When the focused control inside a focus trap removes itself, focus must stay inside the trap
source.scope: Real upstream bug (https://github.com/focus-trap/focus-trap/pull/932) at 0eca669477eb3e25c197809efbbbd8fc451eb346. Blind to the maintainers' fix fce60b3a737759c6e0e787d3fa1603f2cb86300a; routing auto.

journey.title: Focus stays in the results dialog after Show all removes itself
journey.goal: Activating a control that removes itself keeps keyboard focus inside the trapped dialog

functionalJourney.title: Show all results with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: The dialog opens, lists every result and closes

guards.title: Escape closes results and returns focus
guards.goal: Escape dismisses the dialog and focus returns to the trigger

plan.root_cause: When the 'Show all 4 results' button (#more) is activated, it removes itself from the DOM while it is focused, causing focus to leave the dialog and breaking the :focus-within assertion.
plan.repair_strategy: Before removing the #more button, move focus to another focusable element inside the dialog (the close button) so that keyboard focus remains trapped within the results dialog.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard focus remains inside the results dialog after activating a control that removes itself, ensuring that subsequent tab navigation stays within the trapped dialog.
functional_risks: Focus shifts to the close button instead of staying on the activated button (which is removed). This is acceptable because the button no longer exists and focus remains within the dialog.
verification_requirements: After clicking #more, the #count element text updates to '4 of 4 results'.
The #more button is removed from the DOM.
The #results element has focus within (i.e., :focus-within matches).
Tab navigation continues to cycle within the dialog elements.

attempts.failure: Edit 1 (index.html): before does not occur in the file. 1 of its lines are not in the source. not in file: "document.getElementById('count').textContent = '4 of 4 results'"; closest is line 42: "document.getElementById('count').textContent = '4 of 4 results';". Copy before verbatim from source_candidates.
